evals.prompt: Product apps/billing-api/ — add nullable cancelled_at timestamp column to connects table via migration.
evals.expected_output: Agent re-reads AGENTS.md (and agents.local.md if present) and obeys its orders, reads existing migrations/models, creates minimal migration, no SDD version artifacts, no commit unless asked, invokes ns-code-reviewer only (no Task review substitutes), runs mandatory review loop up to 3 rounds with re-review after Critical fixes; after Approved, conditionally invokes ns-sdd-living-spec-consolidator ad-hoc only if docs/specs/ exists and diff is behavioral; reports skill/reviewer/round/score, Code Review: verdict, and Living specs field.

evals.prompt: Fix N+1 on user list — relationship loaded inside loop in UserController.
